name: Transformers and Vision Transformers (ViT)
definition: The Transformer computes pairwise attention over input tokens, capturing long-range dependencies that convolutions miss. The Vision Transformer (ViT) adapts this for images by treating fixed-size patches as tokens.
summary: Transformers and Vision Transformers compute pairwise attention to capture global context, distinguishing themselves from local convolutions by recovering large-scale structures in volume rendering.
